text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 11 November, up 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl the previous day, and is 0.3% higher over the week but 29.1% lower over the month. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December 2026 on 1 November. Separately, Genel Energy agreed on 28 September to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
